# Acceptance criteria

- The site opens as static files and works beneath a GitHub Pages repository path.
- Every lesson is traceable to a supplied transcript batch.
- Tutorial facts, clarifications, and additional context are visually and textually distinct.
- Course navigation, search, progress persistence, and responsive reading work without a backend.
- Code examples preserve the tutorial version and identify any improved version.
- Keyboard navigation, focus visibility, semantic headings, contrast, and mobile layout are checked before publishing.
